outcome.technical: Three comment-only edits, no value or behaviour changed. (1) tools/check-report-interactive.mjs: above STACK_BUDGET, stated the rule the shares follow (the stack a class's tightest cell draws in the wide font, plus about one control row, over that cell's height), said the shares were set before the measurement and are not computed from it, explained why the tablet share is smaller than the laptop's (a share is a fraction of height; the portrait tablet cell pins more pixels than the laptop cell yet a smaller part of its screen), and recorded the headroom at each class's tightest cell as a dated 2026-11-17 macOS measurement with the command that re-derives it (node tools/check-report-interactive.mjs <report> 2>&1 | grep lm4, over both committed reports): phone 27px 844x390 (148/175), laptop 37px 1024x768 demo-large chip on (270/307), tablet 52px 834x1194 wide font (306/358), desktop 56px 1920x1080 Verdana demo-large (214/270; page font 182px, so the wide font adds a row there). STACK_BUDGET values untouched. (2) plugins/audit/scripts/report/_report_html.py _global_filter_row docstring: replaced 'this row stays one line' with what the CSS does: compact controls keep the row short, it wraps onto rows with a gap (shell.css .gfilters, date range as one item .gfrange), and the pinned stack's height is held to a per-class budget (lm4), not a line count. (3) tests/test_render_report.py c5b comment: the count now 'keeps its drawn text inside its bar ... free to wrap onto a row of its own or across its own words' (lm3), replacing 'is one line of text'. Gate: sweep 4/4 files ok, 821 cases. Browser checker rc=0 on both reports, run twice (before and after the edit, ~minutes apart): lm4 margins identical both runs. node --check on the mjs rc=0; _output_lints.prose_number_claims() returns an empty list. Dependants: docs/demo-large.html, docs/index.html, examples/acme-store/acme-store-audit.html - still correct, the checker's behaviour is unchanged and only comments moved line numbers (EXPECT_SITES is read off the same file at run time; both reports pass). report-css/controls.css, forced-colors.css, shell.css - still correct, not edited; the docstring now points at shell.css .gfilters/.gfrange, which do wrap (flex-wrap:wrap). tests/test__report_html.py, tests/test__report_usage.py - still correct, no pinned text changed (test__report_html 181 cases green). _report_html importers (_panel_state, _evidence_view, _report_md, _report_page, _usage_load, _usage_viz, render-report, tests/_harness) - still correct, docstring only, no name or output changed; prose naming its status words - untouched. tests/test_render_report.py dependants (.github/sweep-costs.json, render-report.py, tools/affected.py, tests/test__live_copy.py, ui/shared/README.md) - still correct, a comment only, _cases/_selftest unchanged. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md's _report_html section says nothing about the row being one line (grepped), so it stays true. No follower refresh needed: no rendered output changed, and test__refs 292 cases green.
outcome.descriptive: STACK_BUDGET now carries the rule and a dated, re-derivable measurement of each class's headroom; two stale 'one line' comments now describe the wrapping layout.
